title: Lenny Winnemuller
text:
I'm Lenny Winnemuller, based in Amsterdam. I graduated with honors in psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specializing in group behavior, and also hold a degree in entrepreneurship. I've worked as a professional in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada, and today I invest independently.

I also teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program, where I help students build the discipline and frameworks that long-term investing requires.

My mission is simple: to improve financial education and help people master the skill of long-term investing.
section_title: Why I teach investing as a skill
section_text:
Long-term investing isn't about finding the next big idea. It's a skill: making good decisions, consistently, for years. Like any skill, it can be learned. It takes the right method, deliberate practice and someone who gives you honest feedback along the way.

That's why I never give tips or tell anyone what to buy. I teach you how to make your own well-founded decisions, so you never depend on anyone else's opinion again.
seo_title: About Lenny Winnemuller | Long-Term Investing Coach
seo_description: Lenny Winnemuller is an Amsterdam-based coach who teaches long-term investing as a skill. Psychology graduate (honors, University of Amsterdam), worked in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada.
